newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Grenfell strengthens emerging markets team.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Grenfell strengthens emerging markets team.

text.p: Morgan Grenfell Asset Management said on Friday it had strengthened its emerging markets team with eight new appointments.
MGAM, owned by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, said Gavin Grant at Edinburgh Fund Managers, Marina Lloyd at Bear Sterns and Rosie Bichard from DMG's banking division would focus on Latin America.
Richard Rothwell, from Hermes Investment Management, would join in October as head of African equities, and Priya Kodeeswaran from Europa Capital Management would join the eastern European team.

It said it had appointed two new fund managers, Lillian Pang and Sebastian Chia to bolster its team in Singapore. Pang joins from the Government of Singapore Investment and Chia from United Overseas Bank.
Andrew Orchard from MGAM's Singapore office had also returned from London to strengthen the UK-based Asia team.
The appointments follow that of Neil Jenkins as head of emerging markets in June and the departure of three fund managers who moved to Caspian Securities, also in June.
